content:
Maya Chen: Quick sync — we need to lock the MVP for the observability console this sprint. Proposed minimal surface: 1) per-route + per-API-key token cost breakdown, 2) 95/99 latency histograms, 3) tracing hooks on hot-path only (root span + model-call spans), 4) error analytics with grouping + sample logs. Thoughts?
Arjun Patel: Lean into root+model-call spans only. Full-span capture will blow storage/cost for early beta.
Sam Rivera: +1. Root+model-call + attach request metadata is high signal. Avoid full-span capture for now.
Priya (PM): Customers repeatedly ask for cost attribution by API key and by model. Need API-key filter in the dashboard slice.
Maya Chen: Ok add API-key filter. We should set concrete launch criteria: minimal signals, sampling defaults, canary plan, and rollback gates.
Arjun Patel: Suggested launch criteria: dashboards surface per-key cost and per-model cost; latency 95/99 charts; trace link from an error to span; sampling config exposed (default trace sample 1%). Canary: 10% -> 50% -> 100%.
Sam Rivera: On sampling: separate sampling for traces vs error capture. Capture metadata for 100% of errors, full trace only if sampled.
Maya Chen: Decision: errors always emit small error event (meta + trace id). Full traces stored only for sampled requests. That keeps SLO debugging while containing cost.
Priya (PM): Timeline ask: prototype by EOW, internal dogfood next week, public beta in 3 sprints. Need to confirm infra availability for retention/agg.
Arjun Patel: Add infra guard: retention beyond 7 days needs approval and cost review. Also store hourly aggregated cost to reduce time-series cardinality.
Sam Rivera: Dev tasks: instrument route-level metrics, plumb API-key -> cost attribution, add trace hook in model client, implement sampling config UI. I'll own trace hook + sampling config.
Maya Chen: I'll own launch criteria doc and canary/rollback plan. Priya will coordinate early beta customers with Sales.
eng-bot: Note: deploy pipeline will require feature flag OBS_NEW_DASH (default off) and infra quota ticket when enabling >10% traffic.
Priya (PM): Action items summarized: @Sam Rivera implement trace hook & sampling; @Maya Chen publish launch criteria & rollback; @Arjun Patel add infra guard + aggregate cost job; @Priya (PM) sync with Sales for beta customers. Ping if blockers.
Arjun Patel: One open risk: cost estimation accuracy with sampling. Need sample-based extrapolation algorithm and clear UI labeling "estimated" vs exact.
Maya Chen: Good point — add an explainer tooltip and "estimated" badge where appropriate.
Sam Rivera: Will add estimation note to the UI and API responses. Also add a /debug endpoint to fetch raw sampled traces for investigations.
Maya Chen: Final ask: runbook gate — if 99th latency regresses >20% post-canary, auto-rollback to previous model variant/config. Agree?
Priya (PM): Agreed. Put rollback as a hard launch criterion.
All: :thumbsup:
Maya Chen: Thanks, updating the roadmap issue now and will attach the prototype checklist and timelines. If no blockers, we'll scope tickets for next sprint planning.
